text:
I try to write your name in the dark.

I try to write that I love you.

I try to say all this in darkness.

I don't want anyone to find out,

anyone to see me at three in the morning

pacing from one side of the room to the other,

mad, full of you, in love.

Illuminated, blind, full of you, spilling you.

I say your name with all the silence of the night,

my gagged heart shouts it.

I repeat your name, say it over again,

say it tirelessly,

and I am sure that morning will come.

translation.title: I Try to Write Your Name in the Dark...
